title: Compression and switching at a single gate
statement:
Fix $n \ge 1$, an integer $l \ge 1$, and a natural number $t$, and write $D(g)$ for the decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $g$ on $n$ variables, that is, the least depth of a decision tree computing $g$. For a function $g$ and a restriction $\rho$ on the $n$ variables, let $g\!\restriction_{\rho}$ denote the function obtained from $g$ by fixing each coordinate to the value $\rho$ assigns it and leaving the coordinates $\rho$ marks free as inputs. Let $c_1,\dots,c_m$ be Boolean circuits on $n$ variables, and let $F$ be the function computed by a single AND gate, or by a single OR gate, applied to $c_1,\dots,c_m$; the bound below holds for either gate. Suppose a restriction $\rho_1$ satisfies $D\!\left(c_i\!\restriction_{\rho_1}\right) \le l$ for every $i$. Draw a random restriction $\rho_2$ under which each of the $n$ variables is independently left free with probability $p = \tfrac{1}{40 l}$ and otherwise fixed, taking each of the values $0$ and $1$ with probability $\tfrac{1-p}{2}$, and let $\rho_1 \circ \rho_2$ be the composite restriction that keeps every value fixed by $\rho_1$ and applies $\rho_2$ to the coordinates $\rho_1$ leaves free. Then
\[
  \Pr_{\rho_2}\!\left[\, D\!\left(F\!\restriction_{\rho_1 \circ \rho_2}\right) > t \,\right]
  \;\le\; \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t} + \exp\!\left(-\frac{n}{120\, l}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: gate is a single AND or OR gate (isAnd)
children c₁,…,c_m are Boolean circuits on n variables
an initial restriction ρ₁ is given
each child restricted by ρ₁ has decision-tree depth ≤ l
ρ₂ is a Bernoulli restriction with free-probability 1/(40l) and each fixed value taken with probability (1-p)/2
composition applies ρ₁ first then ρ₂ on the free coordinates
replaced:
Suppose $0 < l$, $0 < n$, and every child $c \in cs$ satisfies
$\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,c.\mathrm{eval}\,\rho_1) \le l$. Then under a further
Bernoulli random restriction $\rho_2$ with parameter $1/(40 l)$, the probability that the
restricted node $\mathrm{restrictFn}\,(\mathrm{eval}\,(\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs))\,(\mathrm{composeRestr}\,\rho_1\,\rho_2)$
has decision-tree depth greater than $t$ is at most
\[
  \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t} + \exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120 l}\right).
\]
